name: Who coordinates a project: the CAP_COORDINATE check and the coordinators list
summary: A caller coordinates a project when Service.check_authority(principal, project, CAP_COORDINATE) passes: a member whose role holds coordinate (coordinator, owner) or a personal agent whose coordinator grant has effect now (GRANT_CAPABILITIES). Service.coordinators_of lists the same set for any reader (people and agents, display names only). Every route authorizes through check_authority, which runs http_authority.decide, the same decision the endpoint re-runs before an effect.
